archetypes.name: dyn-artifact-trust
archetypes.rationale: The change introduces descriptor-bound reads, contained writes, and snapshot-root reuse rules across security-sensitive artifact paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the trusted I/O primitives and every changed coverage or snapshot consumer for symlink, ancestor, containment, file-type, replacement-race, and cleanup gaps. Confirm absent artifacts remain distinct from unsafe or partial present artifacts and that no validation is followed by an ordinary path-based reopen. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
